_comment: RLL4-layout kit textures (resources/old-jerseys) -> RL26 kits; rows with "custom" are kits painted in RL26's own layout (resources/custom-kits/<custom>/top|shorts|socks.png, tools/jersey_template.py), guids 64001+ (61001-61109 are team-coaches' polos). guid is the design guid used for the new uniformTop/Bottom/Socks items (one per kit, same number in all three maps); texture names the new characters/uniforms/textures/m_{top,shorts,socks}_<texture>_col_{1,2} entries.
